note: Foundry landform (PROGRAMME.md Appendix C§1, ADR-0018): a works cut into a hillside. Three slag terraces step ~8 m each from the spawn gate (west, x=-40) down to the core basin (east, x=36): T1 at +16 m holds westGate and the g7..g11/g23 sockets, T2 at +8 m holds the spawn yard, the deck (an overlook off the middle terrace) and the mid-lane sockets, T3 at 0 m holds the core-side sockets and the basin the core pools in. The terrace edges are placed from the legacy level file (unreal/content/levels/legacy/foundry.level.json): each is >= 3 m from every ground socket so the sockets sit on terrace tops, and the legacy 'ground' route crosses each edge on a leg with room for a <= 30 % ramp (edge 1 on the z=14 leg, edge 2 on the z=-8 leg). A spur at T1 level runs east off the high terrace on the north side for WS-37's vent tunnel; a cinder ridge loops the belt beyond containment with slag heaps behind it. Frame: sim metres, x right, +z toward the spawn yard, y up.

features.note: T1/T2 edge: west of it is +8 on top of T2 (= +16). Travels +z, so 'left' = west = the high side. The jog north of z=16 keeps g12 (-16,20) on T2 and g11 (-26,14) on T1.
T2/T3 edge: west of it is +8 (T2). The jog at z=4..8 keeps g5 (12,-2) and g15 (9,4) on T2 and g21 (14,10) on T3; the lane's x=18 leg runs 3 m east of it on T3.
The spur between T1 and T2 on the north side, flat at T1 level (16 m) so the vent tunnel (3 m bore, WS-37) can be bored through it east-west. 3 m flanks.
The core pools 2.5 m below T3; the bowl's steepest slope is ~23 % so g19/g20/g22 stay buildable (< 25 % ungraded). Fog pools here (C§1).
The belt beyond containment: a cinder ridge whose inner foot sits at the playable edge (|x|=55, |z|=40). Additive, so it rides the terraces (crest ~30 m in the west, ~14 m in the east).

The legacy 'ground' route polyline (westGate -> core). Flattened 5 m wide (+2 m shoulders) and re-graded to <= 30 % with balanced cut/fill, so WS-09's projected lane stays walkable across both terrace edges and down into the basin. Applied before the noise, which is masked out of it.

noise.note: Surface roughness on the terrace tops and faces; kept off the lane bed so its grade stays exact.
Broad heaps and hollows in the belt only.

flats.reason: Hero spawn (0,-24), armory (-6,-24) and the spawnYard station (0,-20): the deck's ground floor is a poured slab.
The core (36,6) stands on a level plinth at the bottom of the basin.
